title: The Cheerful Step on the Bread Card
youtube_title: The Cheerful Step on the Bread Card | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity can find the quiet step a recipe forgot to say out loud.
summary: Yara, Pavel, and Sable bake a pretty loaf from the card, then discover the dough needs a pause before the heat and rewrite that cheerful step onto the recipe.
